changelog:
Vanguard v1.0.36
- New Limiter Sessions: host a session and share a code; everyone who joins can be pulsed (3074 / 27k / 30k / 7500 / Reconnect) by the host. Members opt in and can leave anytime; the host can set a member's role to "idiot" to fully control their limiter while they are in the session. Uses the public backend - no login. (Find it in the new Limiter Session card on the dashboard.)
- New Settings toggle "Minimize session / activity widgets": switch the dashboard cards between expanded (stacked, full detail) and minimized (small, side by side).
- Leaderboards: the scrollbars can now be clicked and dragged (mouse-wheel still works too).
